item.title: About
item.description:
Hi there, Link to heading

I am the founder of iCurious.ai, a company focused on AI innovation. Previously, I worked at Databricks where I gained valuable experience in infrastructure and systems engineering. I hold a degree in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences from IIT Kanpur.

Initially, I grew up in a small town in Uttarakhand, then moved to a boarding school in Nainital. After high school, I decided to pursue engineering and somehow ended up in IIT Kanpur. I have always been a curious person and enjoyed learning new things. My interests mostly originate when I come across excellent resources on any subject, mostly my impluse book purchases. I love reading books whenever I get time, and I also like interacting and making connections with people.
